ClientPrefs.description: Per-client preferences. Keys a client does not use are ignored by it.

enabled.description:
`false` opts the client out of everything; `true` forces it on even
when it is not detected.

import_profiles.description: VS Code profiles to import from (`vscode-legacy`).

import_variants.description: VS Code variants to import from (`vscode-legacy`).

project_local_target.description: Where the private project layer goes (Claude Code: `local-scope`).

project_shared_target.description: Where the shared project layer goes (Claude Code: `.mcp.json`).

ProfileSelection.description: "default", "all" or a list of profile ids
